.PHONY: default cover test bdd lint ci release

default: lint test

test:
	@$(BIN)/mocha --colors -R dot $(TEST_FILES)

bdd:
	@$(BIN)/mocha --colors -R spec $(TEST_FILES)

cover:
	@istanbul cover $(BIN)/_mocha $(TEST_FILES) --report lcovonly -- -R spec

lint:
	@$(BIN)/eslint lib spec examples
